mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have a pleasant 70 degrees at Fireman's Park under clear skies with a lovely waxing gibbous moon visible.

The city is currently recruiting for an Engineering Technician to manage construction and infrastructure projects through September 20. Additionally, residents can now apply for the rain barrel rebate program to receive a credit on their utility bill by installing a 35-gallon barrel.

Today is packed with activities, including the Dane County Farmer's Market and live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, tomorrow features a free Girls Try Hockey event at the Verona Ice Arena.
In a report covering notable calls from last week, on Friday, August 15, a 44-year-old woman was arrested for an O W I after officers found her unresponsive in her vehicle.

Culver's is serving up Raspberry Cheesecake as the flavor of the day and they are open until 10:30 PM tonight. You can also catch the Kona Ice truck at the Verona Area High School football game starting at 6 PM today.
